{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for imbalance in key confounders by sex
# Cross-tabulate sex with arm, site, severity
confounders = ['arm', 'site', 'severity']

# Check if any variable is imbalanced
imbalanced = False
for col in confounders:
    crosstab = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df[col])
    # Check if the distribution of sex differs significantly by col
    # Use chi-square test for independence
    from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency
    chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(crosstab)
    if p < 0.05:
        print(f"{col} is associated with sex (p = {p:.4f})")
        imbalanced = True
    else:
        print(f"{col} is not significantly associated with sex (p = {p:.4f})")

if not imbalanced:
    print("No significant associations between sex and any confounder.")"}
